headline: European Natural Gas Prices Rise 3% Amid Middle East Supply Disruptions
summary: Benchmark Dutch TTF natural gas futures jumped 3% as ongoing Middle East escalation restricted Qatari LNG shipments and colder weather prompted initial drawdowns from European gas storage facilities.
why: Title Transfer Facility (TTF) is Europe's primary wholesale natural gas trading hub, setting benchmark energy prices across the continent.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Supply constraints in Qatari LNG combined with increased domestic heating demand drive up futures prices.

why_moved: Rising geopolitical risk and lower LNG flow volumes directly pushed up wholesale gas futures prices.
